commits.message:
fix(progress): TaskProgressColumn is four cells wide and rounds as Python; SpinnerColumn takes progress.spinner (rich-progress-sy9s) (#303)

* fix(progress): TaskProgressColumn is four cells wide and rounds as Python; SpinnerColumn takes progress.spinner (rich-progress-sy9s)

TaskProgressColumn right-aligns Rich's clamped percentage in three cells,
rounds a tie to even as Python's .0f does, and shows nothing for a task
with no total. SpinnerColumn takes style (default progress.spinner),
speed and finishedText, as Rich's does.

* fix(progress): one finished predicate, Rich's finished_time; finishedText drawn in its cell; Spinner runs backwards at a negative speed (rich-progress-sy9s, rich-progress-qjm9)

Review (high) findings on #303. SpinnerColumn and Progress.finished now ask
one predicate over Rich's sticky finished_time, set when an update finds a
started task at its total; Progress.finished is Rich's all() and so true with
no tasks. A RichText finishedText is copied and drawn at its natural width.
Columns returning segments rather than a renderable is rich-progress-j4lb.
